Question 1
?

Let f(x,y,z) be a function that is differentiable at each point on the line segment AB―, where a=⟨5,−3,2⟩ and b=⟨−4,6,−2⟩ are the position vectors of A and B, respectively. If f(a)=9 and f(b)=3, then what is missing from the statement below?

The mean value theorem states that there exists a point C∈AB― with position vector c such that |_______________.

a
9fx(c)−3fy(c)+4fz(c)=12
b
−5fy(c)+5fz(c)=12
c
6fx(c)+4fz(c)=−6
d
9fx(c)−5fy(c)+6fz(c)=−6
e
−9fx(c)+9fy(c)−4fz(c)=−6
Submit
